services.desc: Another great day on the water fishing in the rain today. We got a couple of guys out early this morning right after legal fishing time and we caught them lots of fish and were done before the sun even rose. Next trip started at 10:30 and it was awesome. We caught probably 20 Spoonbill and they left taking one to see if they like to eat them. My covered boat made it nice fishing in the rain today and as always my clients really enjoyed it also.
